notes.purpose: Litters and their sows to check at weaning, by pen; lens To check / Checked / All. A pen-level task: the row is the litter, keyed under its pen and sow. Tap the row.

elements.name: Task row
elements.shows: one sow (or litter): tag, one fact line, one memory line, rail

states.shows: Checked · 5 kept, "20 head · 8.9 kg · 10:20 G.H", edit pencil

elements.logic: Line 1 is words (state + when), line 2 is tokens (history, stamps). A chip appears only for an escalated measurement or a flagged observation; stamps appear on done rows and on rows that descend from a record. Everything on the row is derived; the worker types nothing here.

elements.name: Lens row
elements.logic: Only these states are drawn in the earlier deck.

elements.name: Unit KPI and Task overview
elements.shows: 10 kg average weaning weight, target by day-age; Task overview "100/200 pens", day 3 window
elements.logic: Weaning is pen-level: its progress counts pens, not sows. The KPI basis is not documented.

issues: Pre-Astra look: rows, header and dock predate the Astra task skeleton.

notes.purpose: The sheet behind the Task overview cell for weaning check: whole-task progress, KPI, configuration, SOP link and, where the task has one, End task. What failed the "does this change what a hand does at the pen right now?" test lives here, one tap from the room.

elements.name: End task
elements.rule: The archive deck draws a sheet for weaning; the docs give no End task rule for it beyond the general split (sweep tasks always, event tasks never).

elements.name: Configuration
elements.logic: Starts on weaning day, day 21; records the litter and the sow status. No further configuration is documented.

elements.name: Unit KPI
elements.logic: Two KPIs: average weight by day-age and percent survival, target 90 or more. The formulas are not documented.

issues: Pre-Astra look: header, KPI cells and sheet styling predate the Astra task skeleton.

notes.purpose: The litter record, opened by tapping the row: piglets weaned, kept for breeding and average weight; a sow status form follows on the same sheet.

elements.name: Litter record
elements.shows: weaned count, kept for breeding, average weight
elements.rule: One litter record per save. The sow half is the same assessment as the postpartum check (archive screens section 04b: 'weaning (sow half)'). A done row is corrected with the pencil, audited. The interaction plan also lists a sex split, which this sheet does not show.

issues: The Figma flow also has an already-submitted state and a piglet-information step; neither is drawn in the earlier deck.

notes.purpose: For weaning: the unit as it stands when piglet processing ends, so weaning starts from a known state. Opened from the ended piglet-processing task.

elements.name: Counts
elements.shows: alive and identified piglets, litters weighed, unexplained loss
elements.logic: Alive and identified count piglets in the unit now; litter weights count litters weighed at the weigh day (day 21), naming litters not yet at that day; unexplained loss counts piglets still open.

elements.name: Not done at end
elements.shows: treatments left undone when the task ended, by dose, with the litters and a door to each
elements.rule: A dose left undone on several litters opens a list of those litters; on one litter it opens that litter. A line says when a mark was made after End.

issues: Overlaps the Wean feature (Breeding and litters), which draws the weaning check too; see the filed decision.

screens.name: Keep breeders and fill IDs
screens.zh: 选择留种猪只 / 填身份

notes.purpose: Choose breeders, match piglets and fill or add identity (选择留种猪只, 选择匹配猪只, 填身份, 补充身份).
Read-only list, weaning detail, piglet information (edit state) and task detail after the task ends.
